en-US:
Gifts and Gram transfers are easier to read, with clearer cards and details you can open from the chat.

Gift cards show the whole gift alongside the sender’s message, with colours drawn from the gift or your theme. Tap to view the gift details.

Gram transfer cards now show the amount prominently, followed by any available comment and the transfer status. Cards follow your theme colour. Encrypted comments show a lock and a clear label. Transaction IDs stay in the details instead of appearing as chat text, and unrecognised message types show an unsupported-message notice.

On iPhone and iPad, turn on Simple mode in Appearance for a simpler message bar. In this mode, bot chats use a command icon or Mini App icon to match the action, with voice messages available under More.

Close a pinned-message bar and it stays hidden when you reopen the chat, until a message is newly pinned. Text and icons also fit more consistently at larger text sizes.
zh-Hans:
礼物和 Gram 转账现在以更清晰的卡片呈现，点按即可查看详情。

礼物卡片完整显示礼物和赠送人的留言，并采用礼物本身或当前主题的颜色。点按卡片即可查看礼物详情。

Gram 转账卡片突出显示金额，下面保留可显示的留言和转账状态，颜色跟随当前主题。加密留言显示锁图标和明确提示。交易 ID 仅在详情中显示，不再作为聊天文字出现；无法识别的消息类型会显示暂不支持的提示。

在 iPhone 和 iPad 上，可在「外观」中开启「简洁模式」，让消息输入栏更清爽。在此模式下，机器人聊天会根据实际操作显示指令或小程序图标，语音消息入口收纳在「更多」中。

关闭聊天中的置顶消息栏后，重新打开聊天时仍保持隐藏，直到有消息被新置顶。同时优化大字号下的文字和图标显示。
